existing_receiver_replay.scope_notice: Original-program mathematical optimality only; no statistical provenance, transport validity, or infeasibility claim.

assumptions_verbatim: Users are iid study-user blocks; within-user items, sources and groups may be dependent.
Each source has a static binary potential rating vector; no panel-composition or order interference within source.

R selects a uniformly random 16-subset without replacement from all 300 items independently of its potential rating vector and independently across user blocks. This SRSWOR condition is declared, not established by released collector code.

O item-inclusion propensity is positive conditional on latent U and renders potential rating independent of inclusion given U; only outcome-conditional expected inverse inclusion weights are bounded by Lambda.
Fixed O24 independent uniform thinning preserves p and the outcome-conditional weight ratio, so original Lambda keeps its meaning. Full inclusion consistency is stronger than thinned consistency.
Group-only methods transport only ideal uniform group means within rho; full-cell controls additionally require static full-cell transport.

metadata.target: Study-user-generating distribution under iid user blocks, not a general consumer population

statistical_scope.fixed_view_conditional_confidence_level: 0.95 under declared iid-block, selection, sensitivity and transport assumptions; no empirical coverage claim.
statistical_scope.budget: Fusion .025 per source, original .025/31 per randomized row retained when selecting the 16-row subview; standalone controls use full .05.
statistical_scope.declaration: Lambda=1.5, rho=0; retrospective selected illustration of existing results, not fresh confirmation or a joint guarantee over tested declarations.
statistical_scope.mathematical_guarantee: For every mean vector in this trusted confidence set, the returned policy improves expected binary rating over uniform by at least the stated capacity; a saved feasible witness supplies the matching family upper bound.
